title: Shows like Wolf 359
description: Character-first sci-fi comedies and adjacent ensemble stories that can grow larger if you stick with them.
label: Station-comedy afterglow

showReasons.eos-10: The closest station-comedy cousin if the ensemble friction is the thing you want more of.
showReasons.midnight-burger: A warmer, more idea-rich branch if you want heart and range after the station setup.
showReasons.oz-9: Pushes the comic chaos much harder for listeners who want more incompetence per square foot.
showReasons.wooden-overcoats: Transfers the ensemble timing and recurring petty disasters into a very different setting.
showReasons.station-151: A colder, weirder outpost variation for listeners who liked the location-based absurdity.
showReasons.crystal-blue: A smaller quick-hit branch for more offbeat sci-fi comedy energy.
showReasons.oblivity: Another station-adjacent comedy where crew chemistry and institutional absurdity matter as much as the premise.
showReasons.we-fix-space-junk: A stronger road-trip branch if the listener wants comic space stress and damaged people stuck together.
